properties.source: Initial state: satellite reconstruction cells (200 m) with first detection at or before 2025-08-27T23:00:00Z. Spread: heuristic rate model from simulation.py coefficients, pinned 200 m DEM and hourly single-point Open-Meteo wind, via reconstruction_forecast.propagate.
assumptions: The satellite reconstruction is held fixed at its 23:00 UTC state; it is the start of the model, not an observation of the video period.
Only reconstructed boundary cells first detected within the 12 hours before the start spread; older boundary is treated as no longer active.
Spread is integrated by multi-source minimum travel time (Dijkstra, 8 neighbours), hour by hour with the wind of each UTC hour.
Fuel is uniform and assumed (factor 1); there is no fuel map and no fuel moisture.
Wind comes from one model point and is the same across the domain; humidity and temperature do not change the rate.
Arrival times are model outputs; cells are shown only when the model reaches them and are never observed truth.
limitations: Modelled and not validated: the engine is heuristic, uncalibrated, not Rothermel or FARSITE, and has no spotting or suppression.
The existing engine overpredicts the later reconstruction; the output is an illustration of the assumptions, not a validated forecast or a guaranteed upper bound.

The reference for the evaluation is a later satellite reconstruction, not an independent measurement; it cannot grow beyond the final perimeter, so modelled spread outside it counts as over-prediction.
The reconstruction overstates published area (x1.53 on 25 August, x1.38 on 31 August) and its times are first detections, not the exact front.
The initial mask already uses the retrospective final footprint of the reconstruction and its recent boundary is an inferred proxy for the active front.
The DEM is 200 m (5x5 mean) and underestimates local slopes.

method.integration: Tiempo mínimo multifuente (Dijkstra, 8 vecinos) desde TODAS las celdas de la máscara reconstruida con t ≤ timeUtc; tasa = base·combustible·W·S, W = exp(KW·v·cos(rumbo − haciaDondeSopla)), S = clamp(exp(KS·dz/dist), S_MIN, S_MAX); el viento se toma de la hora UTC vigente y se integra tramo a tramo al cruzar cada hora (FIFO).
method.seedSelection: boundary cells of the initial mask whose reconstruction time lies in (start - 12 h, start]

initialState.class: reconstructed from satellite detections; not a mapped front

bias.initialFinalPerimeterBias: The initial mask is cut from the reconstruction of the final perimeter, which is known only retrospectively; the reference cannot exceed it.

evaluation.metricDefinition: iou = |predicted ∩ reference| / |predicted ∪ reference| over 200 m cells; growthIou is the same restricted to cells outside the initial mask. Predicted = initial + cells reached by the model at the overpass time; reference = reconstruction cells with first detection at or before the same time.
evaluation.referenceClass: later satellite reconstruction; not independent validation
evaluation.note: Both sides are evaluated at exactly the overpass time. The reconstruction is confined to the final perimeter, so this is biased towards over-prediction. If growthReferenceAreaHa is 0 the reconstruction records no new cells by that overpass (the satellite reconstruction is frozen), so growthIou is 0 by construction and says nothing about spread skill.
